scientific_limitations: The theorem gives ordinary global Euler characteristic, not local Euler obstruction, Betti numbers, degree, or Hilbert series.
It is restricted to permutation-indexed symmetric Schubert determinantal varieties, not arbitrary symmetric ladder or type-C Kazhdan-Lusztig varieties.
The torus-localization proof is short, so an older unindexed observation remains possible.
title: Euler characteristic of a symmetric matrix Schubert variety is a two-order-statistic count
